sources.note: Main landing page. Describes VersaSuite as adaptive EHR with 36 modules, ONE database/ONE framework design. Targets specialty hospitals, acute care, critical access, behavioral health, LTAC. Dual platform: desktop client-server and VersaWeb.

ONC certification page. Lists VersaSuite 9.0 certification from Drummond Group. Describes EHI export capability under §170.315(b)(10). Notes FHIR API pricing ($150/provider/year outpatient, $50/bed/year inpatient). Describes product as HIS|EHR|EPM|ERP.

Solutions overview page. Lists four main systems (HIS, EHR, EPM, ERP) with inpatient, outpatient, and administrative solutions. Lists core modules: Document Management, EHR, HIS, LIMS, Payroll, Pharmacy, POS, RIS/PACS, Reports/Letters.

Inpatient solution page. Lists modules: EHR, DMS, EMAR, Pharmacy, CPOE, LIMS, Clinical Nutrition & Food, eTAR, Inventory & Materials Management, POS, Patient Portal, Provider Portal. Describes patient flow from admission to discharge.

EHR features page. Describes specialty-specific templates, drawing component, voice dictation integration (Dragon, M*Modal), keyboard-free data entry, one-click PACS/CPOE/EMAR/ETAR access. Supports inpatient, ambulatory, ED. Lists facility types including FQHC/RHC, home health, dental.

Company history. Founded 1994 as Universal Software Solutions Inc. (USSI), DBA VersaSuite since early 2000s. Based in Austin, TX. Single core development team since 1997. Serves clinics, surgical centers, hospitals globally.

ERP features page. Lists modules: Accounting/GL, AR/AP, Payroll, HR, Time & Attendance, Employee Scheduling, Budgeting, Facility Management, Procurement, Risk and Compliance Management. Embedded within clinical system for real-time financial reconciliation.
EMR/EHR software page. Lists all modules including CPOE, EMAR, ETAR, LIMS, RIS/PACS, Pharmacy, HIM, HIS, EPM, ERP, HR & Payroll, Accounting. Automation from admission to discharge.

Specialty hospitals page. Lists CPOE, EHR, EMAR, EDIS, HR, LIMS, RIS/PACS modules. Notes security exceeding HIPAA & MIPS requirements. Targets critical access, rural, specialty, acute care, behavioral health, LTAC.

Critical access hospitals page. Describes clinical features: chief complaint, problem/illness history, review of systems, rapid charting. One-click access to RIS/PACS, CPOE, EMAR, ETAR, Billing, Demographics. Voice dictation integration. Seamless EPM integration.

Outpatient solution page. Lists modules: EHR, CPOE, EPM, DMS, Patient Portal, Provider Portal, Inventory Management, POS, Reports. Covers scheduling, check-in, exam, diagnosis, medications, prescriptions, labs, imaging, billing.
Medical records page. Describes EHR, CPOE, EMAR, ETAR, LIMS, RIS/PACS, HIM, ERP, Pharmacy. Notes automatic billing code transmission. Task creation and multi-patient record access.

Employee portal page. Self-service for personnel management, time & attendance, PTO, compensation/direct deposit, communication. Manages employee demographics, payroll, duties, PTO history, dependent/disability info, attendance/tardy records.

SoftwareFinder listing. Describes cloud-based EHR for inpatient/outpatient. Lists integrations: AxiaMed, Microsoft, TruCode, Acuant, CVS Caremark, Eyemaginations. Custom pricing. Only 1 review (5 stars). 24/7 support. English and Spanish.

Capterra UK listing (found via search). Sparse review data. Positive reviews noted flexibility, comprehensive features, strong training/support, cost-effectiveness. Negative notes: steep learning curve, occasional glitches.
